name: Month 1–3 curriculum
principle: Become the Sanskrit alphabet first. Mālinī second. Breath groups third. Goswami tools later.

months.title: Become the Sanskrit alphabet (Mātṛkā only)
months.goal: Perfect pronunciation + Devanāgarī recognition while installing letters in the body.
months.success: Someone says gha and three things fire instantly: घ, its articulation, its bodily location.

weeks.target: इ/ई instantly means eyes; ऋ/ॠ instantly means nostrils

months.title: Mālinī — scrambled Śākta body
months.goal: Memorize Mālinī order na→pha not just verbally but as one bodily procession.
months.end_state: Run na → … → pha as one uninterrupted procession.
months.note: Abhinavagupta: nyāsa may be made with Mātṛkā, Mālinī, or both; Mālinī nyāsa brings the Śākta body into predominance.

months.title: Add breath properly
months.goal: Groups on single exhalations; continuous trajectory, not five disconnected spots.
examples: exhale: ka kha ga gha ṅa — feel complete right-arm sequence
exhale: ca cha ja jha ña — feel left
months.then: Change vocal depth: audible → quiet → whisper → mental → soundless recognition.

months.later: Goswami tools only — fine breath control, elemental geometry, bindu-concentration, visualization contraction. Two coordinate systems: Mātṛkā/Mālinī phonemic body + bhūta/cakra elemental-axial body. Investigate superimposition only after both are stable.

decoupled_for_now: 1:4:2 nāḍī śodhana may continue as separate session if completely comfortable; not a prerequisite for Month 1–2 nyāsa.
